description: Rules from spec/04-recipe.md: manual, build, generative and hybrid production.

vectors.name: recipe/member-must-be-object
vectors.description: A recipe is an object; a bare kind string carries no inputs or parameters.

vectors.name: recipe/kind-required
vectors.description: Without a kind the reader cannot tell a build from a generation.

vectors.name: recipe/kind-vocabulary
vectors.description: 'assisted' is not one of the four production kinds.

vectors.name: recipe/build-source-required
vectors.description: A build that does not name its source cannot be inspected, let alone repeated.

vectors.name: recipe/build-toolchain-required
vectors.description: The source without the toolchain does not describe a build.

vectors.name: recipe/build-accepted
vectors.description: A complete build recipe: source, toolchain, environment and a determinism claim.

vectors.name: recipe/build-tool-version-recommended
vectors.description: Recording a tool version is a SHOULD (REC-5); a tool named without one must not invalidate the record.

vectors.name: recipe/generative-prompt-required
vectors.description: A generative recipe without the prompt is a claim with no evidence.

vectors.name: recipe/generative-model-required
vectors.description: The tool must name the model; 'higgsfield' alone does not identify what produced the bytes.

vectors.name: recipe/generative-snapshot-or-timestamp
vectors.description: When the provider publishes no snapshot, the generation timestamp is mandatory.

vectors.name: recipe/generative-accepted
vectors.description: Tool, model, snapshot, prompt, seed, parameters and an honest determinism claim.

recipe.prompt: Static camera, locked. A hand presses a brick onto the top course.

vectors.name: recipe/prompt-verbatim-accepted
vectors.description: The prompt is stored as sent: newlines, quotes and non-ASCII text survive unchanged.

recipe.prompt:
Negative prompt: "blurry", no zoom.
Cámara fija — ladrillo sobre el muro.

vectors.name: recipe/inputs-must-be-array
vectors.description: Inputs are a list of (ref, role) pairs, not a map.

vectors.name: recipe/input-role-required
vectors.description: An input without a role cannot be interpreted by a reproducer.

vectors.name: recipe/input-ref-must-be-identifiable
vectors.description: A local nickname such as 'R4-C1' is not a Variorum id and not a URI.

vectors.name: recipe/inputs-accepted
vectors.description: Inputs referenced by Variorum id and by absolute URI, each with a role token.

steps: Composite the still over the plate.

vectors.name: recipe/manual-steps-accepted
vectors.description: A manual recipe may be nothing but an ordered list of steps.

vectors.name: recipe/hybrid-stages-required
vectors.description: A hybrid recipe without stages describes no pipeline.

vectors.name: recipe/hybrid-stage-kind
vectors.description: Stages are build or generative; 'manual' is not a stage kind.

vectors.name: recipe/hybrid-stage-rules-apply
vectors.description: A generative stage must satisfy the generative rules, including the prompt.

vectors.name: recipe/hybrid-accepted
vectors.description: A build stage followed by a generative stage, each complete.
